title: Osprey：目标无关预训练打造更强的投机解码草稿模型
summary: Osprey 提出从现成的小型预训练语言模型引导草稿模型，将广泛预训练视为可复用的目标无关资产，通过剪枝、目标无关下一词预训练及词汇对齐、零初始化QKV扩展和目标蒸馏适配各目标模型，在Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.3-70B和MiniMax-M2.5上平均接受长度分别提升16.1%、21.2%和22.7%。
summary_en: Osprey bootstraps speculative decoding drafters from off-the-shelf pretrained small language models, treating broad pretraining as a reusable target-agnostic asset. It prunes to a shallow backbone, restores language modeling via target-agnostic next-token pretraining, and adapts per target with vocabulary alignment, zero-initialized QKV expansion, and distillation. A single backbone improves mean acceptance length by 16.1% (Qwen3-8B), 21.2% (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct), and 22.7% (MiniMax-M2.5).
